Fix specification template device list editing (#90)

## Summary
- Add `device_list` typing to the Theaceae API client for specification records.
- Initialize specification template edit checkbox state from `device_list`, falling back to existing `match_model` behavior when no `device_list` is present.
- Send selected device records in the `/api/v1/app/universal/specification/modify` payload while keeping `match_model` synchronized.
